Current.sql: SELECT v.branch_code, count(*)::bigint AS product_rows, count(v.quantity)::bigint AS nonnull_quantities, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.quantity <> trunc(v.quantity))::bigint AS fractional_quantities, min(v.quantity) FILTER (WHERE v.quantity <> trunc(v.quantity)) AS smallest_fractional_value, max(v.quantity) FILTER (WHERE v.quantity <> trunc(v.quantity)) AS largest_fractional_value FROM ada.branch_stock_snapshots s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('000',s.qty_branch_000),('001',s.qty_branch_001),('002',s.qty_branch_002),('003',s.qty_branch_003),('004',s.qty_branch_004),('005',s.qty_branch_005)) AS v(branch_code,quantity) GROUP BY v.branch_code ORDER BY v.branch_code

History001.sql: SELECT branch_code, count(*)::bigint AS snapshot_rows, count(qty_on_hand)::bigint AS nonnull_quantities, count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty_on_hand <> trunc(qty_on_hand))::bigint AS fractional_quantities, min(snapshot_at) AS earliest_snapshot_at, max(snapshot_at) AS latest_snapshot_at FROM ada.stock_snapshots WHERE branch_code='001' GROUP BY branch_code

HistoryAll.sql: SELECT branch_code, count(*)::bigint AS snapshot_rows, count(qty_on_hand)::bigint AS nonnull_on_hand, count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty_on_hand <> trunc(qty_on_hand))::bigint AS fractional_on_hand, count(qty_base)::bigint AS nonnull_base, count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty_base <> trunc(qty_base))::bigint AS fractional_base, min(snapshot_at) AS earliest_snapshot_at, max(snapshot_at) AS latest_snapshot_at FROM ada.stock_snapshots GROUP BY branch_code ORDER BY branch_code

Totals.sql: SELECT count(*)::bigint AS product_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty_total_all_branches <> trunc(qty_total_all_branches))::bigint AS fractional_totals FROM ada.branch_stock_snapshots

limits: Retained snapshot data only; does not prove never had fractions in older or deleted data.
Regular branch qty_base is null; canonical smallest-unit completeness is not established.
Raw snapshot audit does not verify every Hourly or Shopee projection, or a live Ada source database.
Schema supports decimals; no database type or server API restriction changed.
